freeze_rationale: the swept severities, the curve definition, the macro robustness AUC definition and the degradation check are fixed before any A2 or B1 result exists, so no severity point or aggregation can be chosen after seeing performance

gate_role.statement: the severity curves and the macro robustness AUC are descriptive supplemental evidence; the A2 primary score, its single/mixed condition set, its thresholds and its claim limit stay exactly as frozen, and this evaluator can never be used to rank checkpoints or to relabel a failed primary gate as a success

severity_grid.severity_encoding: single: severity only selects the corruption parameter, the continuous burden is the realized normalized damage and severity is never applied twice
severity_grid.severity_units: dimensionless fraction in [0, 1] of the frozen A1 basis parameter

per_kind_curve.name: mIoU-vs-severity curve
per_kind_curve.intervals: paired location-group bootstrap 95% percentile interval at every reported point

macro_robustness_auc.name: macro-average robustness AUC over the five non-total-missing corruptions
macro_robustness_auc.per_kind_definition: trapezoidal integration of the kind mIoU curve over severity from 0.0 to 0.75 using the four frozen points [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75], divided by the severity span 0.75
macro_robustness_auc.aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean over the five kinds
macro_robustness_auc.interval: paired location-group bootstrap over the 196 groups with 10000 resamples and 95% percentile interval

degradation_check.per_kind_consecutive_rule: for each consecutive severity pair (0.00->0.25, 0.25->0.50, 0.50->0.75) the mIoU difference must be <= the per-kind tolerance
degradation_check.tolerance_note: the revision instruction fixed that a degradation check must exist, not its tolerance or its allowed violation count; both were invented during drafting
degradation_check.macro_endpoint_rule: the unweighted mean over the five kinds of mIoU at severity 0.75 must be <= the clean mIoU
degradation_check.reported_as: a descriptive pass or violation list with the exact kind, severity pair and delta

evaluation.logit_aggregation: FP32 mean of pre-softmax logits over the 10 views

abort_report_on: val sample count not equal to 318
sha256 mismatch against the locked A2 data identity
a declared severity point missing from the curve
failure_handling.on_partial_failure: mark the affected curve point as incomplete-not-reported and keep every other frozen point; never silently interpolate over a missing severity level

inherited_at_lock.source: the A2 corruption basis frozen at lock time
inherited_at_lock.reason: the concrete corruption parameter produced by severity 0.25, 0.50 and 0.75 belongs to the A1 corruption basis actually used by the executed A2 revision, so the constants can only be quoted once that revision is locked

inherited_at_lock.source: the A2 corruption protocol frozen at lock time
inherited_at_lock.reason: the basis identity name must match the basis that produced the evaluated training run, otherwise the curves describe a different corruption than the model saw

inherited_at_lock.source: the frozen A2 or B1 protocol at lock time
inherited_at_lock.reason: checkpoint identities do not exist yet and must be bound to the exact checkpoints this evaluator reads

inherited_at_lock.source: the frozen A2 report definition at lock time
inherited_at_lock.reason: the class set must be identical to the primary protocol or the sweep would not be comparable to it

provisional_defaults_requiring_user_conf.reason: the revision instruction fixed the swept kinds, the severity levels, the curve and the macro robustness AUC, but not every number in this file; the items below were invented during drafting and must not be presented as frozen scientific values
provisional_defaults_requiring_user_conf.note: the frozen elements are the five swept kinds, the levels 0.25/0.50/0.75 plus entire_missing@1.0 and clean, the mIoU-vs-severity curves, the macro robustness AUC definition and the ban on using this evaluator for checkpoint selection or for relabelling a failed primary gate
